   (current_setting('app.role', true) = 'approver' AND status IN ('approved','rejected','pending-second'))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION purchase_tier_guard() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status = OLD.status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF (OLD.status = 'submitted' AND NEW.status = 'approved' AND NEW.amount > 50000)
  OR (NEW.status = 'pending-second' AND (OLD.status <> 'submitted' OR NEW.amount <= 50000))
  OR (OLD.status = 'pending-second' AND (NEW.status <> 'approved' OR current_setting('app.user', true) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
      (SELECT a."approvedBy" FROM "ApprovalAudit" a WHERE a."tenantId" = OLD."tenantId" AND a."purchaseId" = OLD.id
        AND a."toStatus" = 'pending-second' ORDER BY a."createdAt" DESC LIMIT 1))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'two-level approval transition refused' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER purchase_tier_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON "Purchase" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION purchase_tier_guard();

	"context"

	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/app"
	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// adapt converts kernel rejections at the service boundary.
func adapt(err error) error {
	var denied *action.Rejection
	if errors.As(err, &denied) {
		return &protocol.Rejection{Status: denied.Status}
	}
	return err
}

func batch(executor *action.Executor, op action.Operation) protocol.Handler {
	return func(ctx context.Context, u app.Identity, key string, ids []string) (protocol.Result, bool, error) {
		done, replayed, err := executor.Run(ctx, u, op, key, action.Request{IDs: ids})
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, adapt(err)
		}
		return protocol.Result{Field: op.Field, IDs: done}, replayed, nil
	}
}

func New(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, fallback http.Handler) (http.Handler, error) {
	executor, err := action.New(ctx, pool)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	reopen := func(ctx context.Context, u app.Identity, key, id, reason string) (protocol.ItemResult, bool, error) {
		done, replayed, err := executor.Run(ctx, u, reopenOp, key, action.Request{IDs: []string{id}, Reason: reason})
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.ItemResult{}, false, adapt(err)
		}
		return protocol.ItemResult{ID: done[0], Status: reopenOp.To}, replayed, nil
	}
	countersign := func(ctx context.Context, u app.Identity, key, id string, amount int) (protocol.ItemResult, bool, error) {
		done, replayed, err := executor.Run(ctx, u, countersignOp, key, action.Request{IDs: []string{id}, Amount: amount})
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.ItemResult{}, false, adapt(err)
		}
		return protocol.ItemResult{ID: done[0], Status: countersignOp.To}, replayed, nil
	}
	return protocol.Item("reopen", "requester", reopen, protocol.Confirm("countersign", "approver", countersign, protocol.HTTP(protocol.Routes{"/purchases/bulk-approve": batch(executor, approveOp), "/purchases/bulk-reject": batch(executor, rejectOp)}, fallback))), nil
}
